evidence.detail: The class owns two path Strings, a javax.sound.midi.Sequence, Sequencer, Synthesizer, and volume double; no unrelated domain state exists.

Its playback method stops/closes any prior Sequencer, builds a File path from the two configured Strings, loads the Sequence with MidiSystem.getSequence, opens a non-default Sequencer and Synthesizer, wires the transmitter to the receiver, installs a MetaEventListener, applies volume, and starts playback.
Volume updates use Synthesizer channels via MIDI controller 7, MASTER_GAIN when the synthesizer is also a Mixer, or explicit ShortMessage control-change messages as fallback.
The singleton instance is owned by rs/v/a; that live subsystem supplies the two path strings, invokes playback, adjusts volume, and Client invokes the player's public lifecycle method.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the live MIDI sequence playback component. The name stops at the media role and does not infer higher-level game music policy.
